title: Skill-check DC creep from repeated failure (e.g. wind-carvings puzzle) can spiral (DC rising each miss) with no way to just walk away and return later with a different approach besides switching stats, which isn't well telegraphed as a strategy.
where: Old Watchtower / Sunken Shrine verse puzzles
